description: Maine SNAP provides monthly food benefits through EBT. Apply through My Maine Connection or the Office for Family Independence, then complete the required interview.
introduction: Maine SNAP provides monthly food benefits through EBT. Apply through My Maine Connection or the Office for Family Independence, then complete the required interview.

who: The state assesses income, household composition, allowable expenses and other rules. Household members generally buy and prepare meals together.
Spouses and children under 22 living with a parent must be included together even when meals are separate. Ask OFI about student or work-rule exemptions that apply to you.
sections.get: Approved benefits buy eligible food. The decision letter states the award and reporting duties. Maine’s current EBT restriction limits transactions to Maine, New Hampshire and Vermont unless OFI arranges other-state use.
sections.docs: Prepare identity, income and household expense records, such as rent, utilities and dependent-care costs. Submit the items requested in the verification letter and contact OFI if you cannot obtain them by the deadline.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through My Maine Connection linked from Maine SNAP, or call 855-797-4357.
  2. A paper application can also be submitted to OFI by mail, email, fax or at a regional office.
  3. Complete the telephone or in-person interview and respond to verification requests.
sections.after: Keep the decision and follow its reporting and renewal instructions. The current ABAWD time-limit period resets October 1, 2026 and runs through September 30, 2029; ask OFI to document any exemption rather than assuming the reset removes work obligations.

faqs: Can I use the EBT card when traveling?
Current Maine restrictions limit transactions to Maine, New Hampshire and Vermont. Call OFI at 855-797-4357 before requesting use elsewhere.
Yes. Maine requires a SNAP interview, by telephone or in person.
Can a prescreening result approve me?
No. Submit an application for an OFI decision.
What if I cannot get a requested receipt?
Contact OFI before the deadline to ask about an accepted alternative. Keep a record of the response.
